formula.normalized: 2 * (midpoint - min(midpoint over the inclusive lookback bars)) / (max - min) - 1; max == min is a flat_range hold
formula.smoothed: x = 0.33 * normalized + 0.67 * previous_x, then clamp x to [-1 + 0.000001, 1 - 0.000001]
formula.initialization: for every timestamp t, previous_x = 0 and previous_F = 0 before the first of exactly 64 normalized observations ending at t, processed in timestamp order
formula.trigger: trigger(t) = F(t - 1), evaluated independently from its own 64-observation recurrence
formula.long_entry: F(t) > F(t-1) and F(t-1) <= F(t-2) and F(t-1) < -extreme
formula.short_entry: F(t) < F(t-1) and F(t-1) >= F(t-2) and F(t-1) > extreme
formula.required_history: lookback + 64 + 1 rows (F(t-2) needs rows t-2-64-lookback+2 .. t-2); maximum 97 rows at lookback 32

rsi.note: rsi registers short_entries=False, so its arm stays long-only

selection.eligible: complete candle and funding coverage, every dataset scored, no liquidated leg, at least min_train_independent_positions independent positions

base.meaning: manifest fees, per-coin half spread and slippage

stress.meaning: manifest fees unchanged, half spread and slippage doubled

verdict.inconclusive: any coverage refusal, no eligible training selection for an arm, or a held-out sample gate that fails
verdict.pass: complete coverage, every sample gate met, candidate net PnL > 0 at base and stress cost, candidate base mean Sharpe and base mean drawdown-adjusted return both strictly above each selected comparator
verdict.fail: a complete study that misses any pass condition
